summary:
Rejected the reading that negating UniverseHasExistingCause entails UniverseUncaused. U is existential over an existing cause, whereas UniverseUncaused excludes all incoming causal edges. Counterexample from review 4492957391: only the spacetime whole exists and is a spacetime part; a nonexisting concrete candidate c has the sole causal edge c → whole. N1, N2, no self-causation, whole-to-part, containment and the weak causal-concreteness floor item hold, but UniverseUncaused is false. The prose now claims only no existing cause. The existing survivor certificate independently witnesses the stronger uncaused-whole position; it does not turn that position into a consequence of negating U. No theorem, Challenge or premise is changed.

Definition/scope follow-up: UniverseUncaused excludes all candidate edges, while UniverseHasExistingCause requires causer actuality. Reuse existing full endpoint-actuality policy, weaken it to selected-whole-causer actuality and expose the exact positive witness transport. Keep the strongest raw brute-universe alternative, add exact no-existing-cause complement and checked existing/no-edge/only-absent-causers trilemma under explicit EM. Endpoint actuality removes the third generic case; it is not silently built into Ontic. Three finite populated assignments test the scope distinction, with the absent-edge model expressly outside the intended actuality policy and no claim of metaphysical possibility. Eight checked results, all old Challenges/source meanings preserved. See docs/notes/universe-cause-scope-boundary.md.
blocker: The stronger inference needs an explicit causal-endpoint existence premise; it is not added to the argument.
